automatable_note: These ESCs use a button, not a jumper. The INDEX.csv summary names a jumper; the procedure text says 'press and release the button'. The button must be pressed by hand after the entry wait.

manual.action: Press and release the button after 2 s or the tone sequence.

entry.confirm_signal: Tone sequence after the 2 s wait; mode series after the button press.
steps: Connect the motor. Transmitter and receiver on. Throttle to brake (stick back) for modes 1, 2 and 5; to motor-off (stick back) for modes 3, 4 and 7; to motor-off (stick middle) for mode 6.
Wait 2 s or until the ESC sounds its tone sequence.
Operator: press and release the button on the ESC ('Taster').
Wait for the mode series; modes 7 and 9 are reached by waiting for the 7-fold or 9-fold signal.
Move the throttle to full (stick forward) when the wanted mode sounds. Mode 6: then move the stick to brake (back).
The ESC repeats the mode as control output. Disconnect power.

announce.description: The ESC sounds mode 1 as one tone, mode 2 as two tones, and so on, one series after another with a pause between series.

select.description: Move the throttle to full when the wanted mode sounds.

scheme.confirm_signal: Control output: the mode is repeated as tones.
scheme.reset_to_defaults: Program mode 1 (APM); it clears all settings.
scheme.description: Brushless ESC with button entry. Mode N is N tones. Modes 7 and 9 are programmed like mode 3 and only differ in waiting for the 7-fold or 9-fold signal. Mode 8 does not exist.

values.name: APM: reset, stick range learned at every power-up
Glider: brake and cutoff on, optional separate motor-off position
Motor plane / boat: brake off, undervoltage reduction
Competition: maximum brake response, undervoltage and overtemperature cutoff off, current limit off
LiPo undervoltage cutoff, 3 V per cell, added on top of another mode

unknowns: Duration of one tone in ms is not stated.
Gap between tones inside one mode series in ms is not stated.
Pause between two mode series in ms is not stated.
Whether the mode series loops until a mode is selected is not stated.
Time window in ms for moving the throttle to full after the wanted series is not stated.
Duration in ms of the three-tone sequences (ascending and descending) is not stated.
Exact timing of the 'wait 2 s or until the tone sequence' step is not stated beyond the 2 s minimum; the end of the wait is the ESC's tone sequence.
Button location on the ESC is not stated.
Mode 9 needs a mode other than mode 1 programmed first; the manual says 'any mode except mode 1'.
notes: INDEX.csv summarises the entry with a jumper; the manual describes a button. The summary is wrong for this file.
Mode 8 does not exist: the manual prints 'Modus 8 - nicht vorhanden'.
Mode 6 is programmed with the stick at motor-off in the middle (Kontronik_Smile.pdf p.9 DE, p.22 EN): entry_throttle mid.

Mode 6 moves the stick to the brake position (back) after the full-throttle selection (Kontronik_Smile.pdf p.9 DE, p.22 EN): after_select min, made STORE after the selection; the manual gives no time.
